A '''mission''' to [[Alashan]] was assigned to [[Arlo Tyre]] and [[Wadie Firestone]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in order to investigate why they had lost contact with their archaeological station on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==The mission==
[[Arlo Tyre]] and [[Wadie Firestone]] were assigned by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alashan]] and investigate why they had lost contact with their archaeological station. When they had gotten there, all of the habitation domes had burst from the inside out. When Arlo and Wadie started to walk towards the central habitat dome, Arlo was suddenly shot and killed by an unknown force. Wadie then ran for his [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] fighter. When he reached his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], he powered the fighter up and accelerated upward, but was shot out of the sky by the same unknown force that killed Arlo.

[[File:Guardian6.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Guardian of Forever.]]

==Aftermath==
Because Alliance Command had lost contact with Arlo and Wadie, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Mici Shabandar]], and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] were assigned to investigate their disappearance.
